user_query: I'm working on a language learning app and I need a database of commonly used words and phrases in different languages. Can you provide me with a list of frequently used phrases in multiple languages? Also, suggest a translation API that can help me integrate real-time translations in the app.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of commonly used words and phrases in multiple languages.
Identify and evaluate available translation APIs to suggest for real-time translation integration.
Integrate the selected translation API into the language learning app for real-time translation functionalities.
